card.name: Science explainer text, mid-sentence terms
card.fires_on: Scattered words in science-explainer prose about astronomy, geology, climate and ecology, such as rare, peak, lasting, occur, centres. No single word type unites them.

modes.label: Verbs and adjectives in findings
modes.description: Words like rare, peak, lasting or occur that complete a claim about a natural phenomenon.

modes.label: Parts of earth-science terms
modes.description: Partway through technical terms in geology or ecology, such as magmatic, recession, cline or community.
